meta.name: rival_river_forts
meta.prompt: Two rival river forts on opposite banks of a wide river, each with its own bridgehead, and a half-built stone bridge that stops in the middle of the water.

programs.brief: A massive cut-stone arched bridge built outward from both banks that stops abruptly mid-river over deep water, complete with broken stone arches, heavy piers, abandoned timber scaffolding, and block-and-tackle hoist cranes.
A heavy war ballista mounted on a stone and timber firing platform facing across the river, with ammo crates, a brazier, and weapon racks.

tokens.terrain: a wide river separating two opposite riverbanks; a fortified river fort and bridgehead on each bank facing each other; a half-built stone bridge extending into the water from the banks and breaking off in the middle
tokens.event_direction: two rival forts facing off across the wide river toward the half-built bridge between them
tokens.region_river_fort_alpha: era medieval, wealth 0.5, formality 0.7, materialTheme temperate_timber; fortification walled; prefer archetypes watchtower, gatehouse, barracks, armoury, dock; props ballista, crane, scaffolding, brazier, banner; heavily fortified bridgehead on the riverbank
tokens.region_river_fort_beta: era medieval, wealth 0.5, formality 0.7, materialTheme temperate_timber; fortification walled; prefer archetypes watchtower, gatehouse, barracks, armoury, dock; props ballista, crane, scaffolding, brazier, banner; rival fortified bridgehead on the opposing bank
tokens.icons: half-finished stone bridge piers and arches ending abruptly mid-stream with abandoned scaffolding; fortified bridgehead gatehouses on each shore; rival watchtowers and artillery emplacements pointed across the water
